newsitem.title: USA: Brazil Fast Food to sell shrs to investor.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Fast Food to sell shrs to investor.

text.p: Brazil Fast Food Corp said Friday it has reached an agreement to sell 1.5 million shares at $3 a share to an institutional investor.
The company said the institutional investor, which invests exclusively in South America, also will receive 250,000 five-year warrants to purchase common shares at $4 a share.
Brazil Fast Food said there are no assurances the transaction will be consummated. It did not name the institutional investor and did not offer a likely closing date.
The company was not immediately available for comment.
